turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Hello Sam, thanks for joining. This is a mock interview for the Backend Engineer role at Northwind Freight, about twenty five minutes. Ready to start?

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Great. Tell me about yourself and what you have been working on recently.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Hi, I'm Sam. I've spent six years building backend services, mostly in Python and Go, for a logistics company.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Thanks. Tell me about a project you are proud of and your own part in it.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The project I'm proudest of is a routing service that cut delivery planning time from two hours to about ten minutes.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Thanks. How did you measure that drop in planning time?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: We measured it by comparing planning logs for three months before and after the release.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Thank you, Sam. That's the end of the interview.
